_comment: Copy to www/config.json (gitignored — never commit a key or a token). The player reads this at boot.
mapillary_token: MLY|… — OPTIONAL. Free, but the studio never creates one: paste it only if you made it yourself at mapillary.com/dashboard/developers. With it, studio/tools/panowalk/fetch.mjs can use Mapillary sequences (denser, often 360°) as well as KartaView (which needs nothing).

_streetview_help.mode: open (our own cached open imagery → embed → link) | embed | link | js | stills. 'auto' behaves as 'open'. Per-browser override: localStorage['yy-sv-mode'].
_streetview_help.cost: open, embed and link call nothing billable. 'js' (Dynamic Street View) and 'stills' (Street View Static) are BILLABLE and are refused unless this file also sets billing_ack: true.
_streetview_help.open: needs frames cached by `node studio/tools/panowalk/fetch.mjs --chapter <chapter>`; stops with no open imagery fall back to embed, then to the card.
_streetview_help.step_m: metres of drift before the walk hops to the next pano in 'js' mode.
_streetview_help.max_stills: hard cap on Street View Static frames per scene in the 'stills' fallback (cost ceiling).
_streetview_help.resume_after_s: seconds of no touching before the auto-walk takes the camera back after a drag.
